Name: FS - Milo's better beanies
Author: milocoolguy06
Description:
Please read the 'readme.txt' in this mods folder!


[b][u]Required to be able to use this mod:[/u][/b]
- SMAPI
- Fashion Sense (version 4.11.3 or higher)

[u]Unzip and place this mod into SMAPI's 'Mods' folder.
[/u]

[b]Where do I find and wear the beanies?
[/b]You can wear the beanies by using the (Fashion Sense) hand mirror that you can buy from Pierre's shop.

[b]Other information: 
[/b]- The beanies color is changeable! The base color is white/gray, and in the hand mirror you can change the color to anything you want.
- This mod does not add the beanies as [u]items[/u] to the game, it only adds it as an extra layer on top of your character. So you can only wear it with the hand mirror.
- If you have any questions (or even suggestions), feel free to comment/post under this mod. I'll reply as soon as I can.

[b]Extra credits:
[/b]- Sleeves on shirt in picture is from mod: FS - SB's Oversized Sleeves
- Shirts (sleeves not included) in pictures are made by me. Some of them are uploaded to my NexusMods profile.
- Hair in pictures is from mod: Ace's Fashion Sense Hairstyles

(If you find any bugs, share them, and I will try to fix them. I take long breaks though, so I'm sorry if my reply isn't any soon.)
